content.text: {"what_it_is": {"claims": [{"text": "Evolved Strategic SATCOM (ESS), budget line 1206855SF, is a U.S. Space Force research-and-development program funded in the Research, Development, Test, and Evaluation, Space Force account.", "citation": {"fact_id": "a5d4a9ea06c012fb"}}, {"text": "ESS is the backbone for Joint All Domain Nuclear Command, Control and Communications (NC3): it is designed to replace Advanced Extremely High Frequency (AEHF) strategic satellite-communications services and provide global, integrated, survivable, and resilient ground and satellite communications for the National Command Authority, Combatant Commanders, and joint warfighters.", "citation": {"fact_id": "ca37d5d356f43b7d"}}, {"text": "The program is meant to provide the only arctic Department of Defense strategic-communication capability across the joint enterprise, offering worldwide secure, jam-resistant communications for strategic ground, sea, and air assets.", "citation": {"fact_id": "ca37d5d356f43b7d"}}, {"text": "ESS is acquired in several parallel efforts to accelerate delivery by a strategic need date in FY 2032, comprising a Space Segment, a Ground/User/Integration Segment, and a Crypto Segment; the Space Segment is converting from a Middle-Tier Acquisition to a Major Capability Acquisition in FY 2025.", "citation": {"fact_id": "ca37d5d356f43b7d"}}, {"text": "The Ground Segment, known as GRIFFON (Ground Resilient Integration & Framework for Operational NC3), includes the Ground Integration and Framework, System of Systems Integration, and mission software applications such as mission planning and command and control to support the ESS Space Segment, operators, strategic users, and joint Combatant Commands.", "citation": {"fact_id": "33af91a46f58e3b6"}}, {"text": "The Space Development and Production effort will design, develop, build, test, and deliver resilient, cybersecure space vehicles, initiating the non-recurring engineering for Space Vehicles 1 through 4 to reach Initial Operational Capability by 2032 and continue through Full Operational Capability.", "citation": {"fact_id": "b99400aacf80f4a4"}}, {"text": "A dedicated End-Cryptographic Unit (ECU) effort develops and delivers NSA-certified units required for secure strategic-communications encryption in the ESS payloads, bus, and payload test terminals, to be provided as government-furnished equipment.", "citation": {"fact_id": "01c81a0e1e26dde6"}}]}, "why_it_matters": {"claims": [{"text": "The program's total funding grows from $918,581 thousand in FY2025 to $1,229,929 thousand (about $1.23 billion) requested for FY2026.", "citation": {"fact_id": "0148419afd1b5832"}}, {"text": "That is a year-over-year increase of $311,348 thousand (roughly $311 million) from FY2025 to FY2026.", "citation": {"fact_id": "e278c00caad16364"}}, {"text": "In FY2024 the program recorded actual spending of $473,622 thousand (about $474 million), so the FY2026 request is more than two-and-a-half times its FY2024 execution level.", "citation": {"fact_id": "bdfcedd6c2273808"}}, {"text": "The entire FY2026 request of $1,229,929 thousand is discretionary funding; there is no reconciliation (mandatory) component in this program element.", "citation": {"fact_id": "10cbebb2cd342967"}}, {"text": "Essentially all of the program's money flows through a single named project, Evolved Strategic SATCOM (ESS), funded at about $1,229.9 million in the FY2026 budget year.", "citation": {"fact_id": "ad39dbe82bdde3c5"}}, {"text": "The same ESS project was funded at about $918.6 million in the current year (FY2025) and about $473.6 million in the prior year (FY2024), tracing the program's steep ramp as development accelerates.", "citation": {"fact_id": "62f53e33e2a5318a"}}, {"text": "The FY2026 request funds Space Segment prototyping, including technology and demonstrations that enable continued development of a modernized strategic payload using competitive rapid-prototyping contracts intended to energize the strategic-SATCOM industrial base and increase competition and resiliency.", "citation": {"fact_id": "ef6487879a4ff71f"}}]}, "players": {"claims": [{"text": "The program is run by the U.S. Space Force, with funding drawn from the Research, Development, Test, and Evaluation, Space Force appropriation.", "citation": {"fact_id": "2f02c494a2d080d9"}}, {"text": "The program's mission narrative identifies ESS as the backbone for Joint All Domain Nuclear Command, Control and Communications (NC3), serving the National Command Authority, Combatant Commanders, and joint warfighters as the replacement for AEHF strategic SATCOM services.", "citation": {"fact_id": "ca37d5d356f43b7d"}}, {"text": "End-cryptographic units for the program are described as NSA-certified, indicating a National Security Agency role in certifying the encryption devices delivered as government-furnished equipment for the ESS payloads and payload test terminals.", "citation": {"fact_id": "01c81a0e1e26dde6"}}]}, "recent_developments": {"claims": []}}
